output.population: Genetically engineered mouse models (GEMMs) of high grade astrocytoma in which RB, KRAS and/or PI3K signaling are perturbed
output.summary: MRI of genetically engineered mouse models of high grade astrocytoma, including anatomic T2 weighted and dynamic contrast enhanced sequences, used for qualitative and quantitative phenotypic characterization of genotypes and molecular subtypes.
